spiritgiven.comments: Chur bro! Thank you for a fun and intense start to the tournament. We would love for the team to familiarise themselves further with the WFDF ruleset, as there were some instances in which the resolution of calls detracted from enjoyment and flow of the game. (e.g. when the handler stood over the disc while discussing strategy - see 8.5) We also thought there was too much pushing off with elbows, although we recognise that our level of contact was also too high. Kia ora!

Arigato Nippon for such a beautiful game! We loved your positivity and the gracefulness of call resolution. We really appreciated the low contact game and the good communication throughout the match. Good luck for the rest of the tournament!

¡Gracias amigas por el partido! We really enjoyed the match against you, the good vibes on the sideline, and your willingness to receive feedback. We think it would be good to review section 18.2 regarding travel calls, and to continue working on minimising body contact. Looking forward to seeing more Venezuelan teams (y culos) in the future!

Danke schön for the amazing game! We were so looking forward to playing you, and the match didn’t disappoint. The contact avoidance was excellent, and your positivity irrespective of the scoreboard was so appreciated. The calls were resolved quickly and respectfully, and we especially liked the spirit circle before the match. Hope to see you again soon for a rematch!

What a bloody good game!!! We loved how positive and high-spirited the game was, despite how close the score was throughout the match. We thought calls were resolved in a really fair manner, but we did notice that in some instances the stall count was not dropped when infractions were called. The communication was top notch, and we really felt all the heart that you brought on the field. Ka pai and kia ora.

GB, GG innit! Thank you so much for a high spirited game. We really appreciated the contact avoidance and the level-headed manner in which calls were discussed. The communication was clear throughout the match, and the closeness of the scoreboard didn’t seem to affect your fair-mindedness at all. Ka pai, kia ora, and ka kite.

TC! What a great game, eh? We had so much fun beavering away against you, and really appreciated all the positivity on and off the field. Calls were fairly and clearly communicated down to every last timbit. We asked for a low contact game and you delivered, even despite the high level of intensity - it really toque our breath away. We’ll be cheering you on in the rest of the tournament, envoie la!

Arigato Nippon for an even better game today. We thought your spirit was so clean in every category, but your positivity was truly exceptional. It felt like we were playing with you rather than against you, and we want to thank you so much for the beautiful energy. This is what ultimate is all about! Tēnā rawa atu koe, ngā mihi nui.

Deutschland, thank you so much for another really well-spirited game. It was a tough match with challenging conditions, and we were so impressed with how positive and calm your team remained despite the closeness of the scoreboard. Jawoll <3

Great Britain, thank you so much for another amazing game. We thought you avoided contact well whenever feasible, and communicated clearly throughout the match. You used hand signals when there was a call, and even helped us clear up an N’SYNC vs. Backstreet Boys discussion on the sideline. Kia pai tō mahi!

spiritreceived.comments: Communication changed  to 3 per Japan request by spirit director

Thank you for the fantastic, tightly fought game.
We appreciate the spirit captains initiating communication and the excellent self-control. Congratulations!
Very spirited game, they kept giving 100% all throughout the game. All calls were resolved quickly and with respect.
Great use of handsignals and calm communication but sometimes players not involved in the call tried to influence the discussion very early.
